citations.short: Buildings of Suitable Size, Construction, Location
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug product do not have the suitable construction to facilitate cleaning, maintenance, and proper operations.

citations.short: Product flow through building is inadequate
citations.long: The flow of components, drug product containers, closures, labeling, in-process materials, and drug products though the building is not designed to prevent contamination.
Equipment for adequate control over temperature is not provided when appropriate for the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of a drug product.
Routine calibration of mechanical equipment is not performed according to a written program designed to assure proper performance.
Representative samples are not taken of each shipment of each lot of components, drug product containers, and closures for testing or examination.
Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not written.

citations.short: Validation lacking for sterile drug products
citations.long: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile do not include validation of the sterilization process.
